messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, do you care
much for flowers?

{07 00 00}If so, you should remember
to water them with your
{ff 00 00 07}watering can{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}That way, they won't die in
winter.{01 00 00 0f 00} Flowers are more
durable than people think!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, kas sa hoolid
väga lilledest?

{07 00 00}Kui jah, siis pea meeles
neid kasta oma
{ff 00 00 07}kastekannuga{ff 00 00 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Nii ei sure nad
talvel.{01 00 00 0f 00} Lilled on tugevamad,
kui inimesed arvavad!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} guess what
happens if you plant a wide
variety of flowers in town?
{07 0a 00}Sometimes, {01 00 00 05 00}you just might
find new types of flowers
popping up!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} arva ära, mis
juhtub, kui sa istutad linna
palju erinevaid lilli?
{07 0a 00}Vahel {01 00 00 05 00}võid sa leida
uusi lilleliike, mis
välja ilmuvad!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Every flower has a special
significance.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 0b 00}Want me to
tell you what they mean?{02 00 00 03 04}
Yeah!
Some other time.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Igal lillel on eriline
tähendus.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 0b 00}Kas tahad teada,
mida need tähendavad?{02 00 00 03 04}
Jah!
Mõni teine kord.

messages.en:
That's fine.{01 00 00 0a 00} It can wait
until you're not so busy.
messages.et:
Hea küll.{01 00 00 0a 00} See võib oodata,
kuni sul pole nii kiire.

messages.en:
Let me give you an
example. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00} Have you heard
of an anemone?
{07 14 00}It's a windflower that
belongs to the buttercup
family, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Anemones symbolize undying
love and fading hope.

Now that I think about it,{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 16 00}that's a pretty confusing
message to send someone.
messages.et:
Las ma toon sulle
näite. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00} Kas oled kuulnud
ülasest?
{07 14 00}See on tuulelill, mis
kuulub tulikaliste
sugukonda, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Ülane tähistab surematut
armastust ja lootust.

Nüüd, kui ma mõtlen,{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 16 00}on see üsna segane
sõnum kellelegi saata.

messages.en:
You know aloe is good for
you, right? That's why it's
in yogurt and skin cream.
Well, {04 1f 00}, {07 0b 00}have you
ever seen the flowers of
the aloe, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}They bloom in fall and
winter, and their flowers
look a little like lilies.
{07 00 00}Aloe flowers symbolize
grief and sorrow.{01 00 00 0f 00} So when
you put aloe on your skin...
{07 16 00}it's kinda like you're
moisturizing yourself with
its tears.
messages.et:
Tead, et aloe on sulle
kasulik, eks? Sellepärast on
see jogurtis ja kreemis.
Nii, {04 1f 00}, {07 0b 00}kas sa oled
kunagi näinud aloe
õisi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Need õitsevad sügisel ja
talvel ja nende õied
meenutavad natuke liiliaid.
{07 00 00}Aloe õied tähistavad
leina ja kurbust.{01 00 00 0f 00} Nii et kui
sa määrid aloed nahale...
{07 16 00}siis on see nagu
niisutaksid end tema
pisaratega.

messages.en:
We don't get them much in
these parts, but {07 0b 00}have you
ever seen apple blossoms?
{07 00 00}They begin as fiery red
buds, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}and then they open
into pinkish white petals.
{07 00 00}Apple blossoms symbolize
{07 17 00}temptation.

{07 00 00}I was tempted once. I saw
an apple on the ground, and
I picked it up and ate it.
{07 02 00}And that's when I saw half
a worm inside! That's right!
HALF!
{07 09 00}I learned a valuable lesson
about temptation that day,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Meil neid siin kandis
palju pole, aga {07 0b 00}kas sa
oled näinud õunaõisi?
{07 00 00}Need algavad tulipunaste
pungadena {01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}ja avanevad siis
roosakasvalgeks.
{07 00 00}Õunaõied tähistavad
{07 17 00}kiusatust.

{07 00 00}Mind kiusati kord. Ma nägin
maas õuna ja ma
võtsin selle ja sõin ära.
{07 02 00}Ja siis ma nägin sees
poolt ussi! Just nii!
POOLT!
{07 09 00}Ma õppisin sel päeval
kiusatuse kohta väärtusliku
õppetunni, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
Have you ever seen cherry
blossoms?{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}Do you want to
know what they symbolize?
{07 00 00}I'm not entirely sure,
myself, but I think they
symbolize deliciousness.
{07 13 00}But maybe that's just
because I love the taste of
fresh-picked cherries!
messages.et:
Kas sa oled näinud
kirsiõisi?{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}Kas tahad teada,
mida need tähendavad?
{07 00 00}Ma pole isegi ise päris
kindel, aga ma arvan, et
nad tähistavad maitsvust.
{07 13 00}Aga ehk on see lihtsalt
sellepärast, et ma armastan
värskete kirsside maitset!

messages.en:
I'm sure you know how
yummy peaches are, but{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0b 00}
have you seen them flower?
{07 14 00}They have small, peach-
colored flowers that bloom
in spring. Go figure, huh?
Because their pits are
trapped in the center of
the fruit, they symbolize
{07 13 00}that you are a captive
of love!{01 00 00 0f 00}

{07 17 00}They also symbolize
longevity, but what's
romantic about that?{01 00 00 05 00} Bleh.
messages.et:
Sa tead kindlasti, kui
maitsvad virsikud on, aga{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0b 00}
kas oled näinud nende õisi?
{07 14 00}Neil on väikesed,
virsikuvärvi õied, mis
õitsevad kevadel. Ennäe!
Kuna nende kivid on
lõksus vilja keskel,
tähistavad need seda,
{07 13 00}et sa oled armastuse
vang!{01 00 00 0f 00}

{07 17 00}Need tähistavad ka
pikka iga, aga mis on
selles romantilist?{01 00 00 05 00} Pläh.

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}are you
familiar with the petunia?

{07 00 00}Petunias are pretty, but,
BOY, do they send a mixed
message, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Get this:{01 00 00 05 00} {07 14 00}a petunia can
mean either that your
presence soothes me.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 15 00}or that I totally resent
you and want nothing to
do with you!
{07 00 00}So if you give someone
petunias,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 19 00} make sure you're
clear about what you mean.
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}kas sa tunned
petuuniat?

{07 00 00}Petuuniad on ilusad, aga
OI, kui segase sõnumi
nad saadavad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Kuula:{01 00 00 05 00} {07 14 00}petuunia võib
tähendada, et su kohalolek
rahustab mind.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 15 00}või et ma põlgan sind
täiesti ja ei taha sinuga
midagi tegemist teha!
{07 00 00}Nii et kui kingid kellelegi
petuuniaid,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 19 00} tee kindlaks, et
su mõte oleks selge.

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} {07 14 00}I'm sure you've
seen all the different
kinds of tulip, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Their meaning changes
depending on the color.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0b 00}Which color do you like?{02 01 00 11 12 13}
Red!
White!
Green!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} {07 14 00}sa oled kindlasti
näinud kõiki erinevaid
tulbisorte, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Nende tähendus muutub
olenevalt värvist.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0b 00}Milline värv sulle meeldib?{02 01 00 11 12 13}
Punane!
Valge!
Roheline!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 0b 00}have you ever
seen an iris?

{07 14 00}You know, they've got soft
petals and sharp, pointy
leaves, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}According to myth, {01 00 00 0f 00}Iris
was a messenger of the
gods, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
But in the language of
flowers, the iris is {07 13 00}the
messenger of love!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 0b 00}kas sa oled
kunagi näinud iirist?

{07 14 00}Tead, neil on pehmed
kroonlehed ja teravad,
teravad lehed, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Müüdi järgi oli {01 00 00 0f 00}Iris
jumalate
sõnumitooja, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Aga lillekeeles on
iiris {07 13 00}armastuse
sõnumitooja!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}What do you think of
heliotropes, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{01 00 00 0f 00}

{07 14 00}They're special favorites of
mine. They're so small and
cute, and those flowers!
{07 0d 00}Oh, don't get me started!
And their fragrance is just
so amazing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}And you'll never guess what
the heliotrope means{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 01 00}
{07 04 00}It means eternal love!
{07 14 00}And it's true:{01 00 00 05 00} I'm going to
love heliotropes forever
and ever, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Mida sa arvad
heliotroopidest, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{01 00 00 0f 00}

{07 14 00}Need on minu erilised
lemmikud. Nad on nii väiksed
ja nunnud, ja need õied!
{07 0d 00}Oh, ära pane mind alustama!
Ja nende lõhn on lihtsalt
nii hämmastav, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Ja sa ei arva kunagi ära,
mida heliotroop tähendab{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 01 00}
{07 04 00}See tähendab igavest armu!
{07 14 00}Ja see on tõsi:{01 00 00 05 00} armastan
heliotroope igavesti
ja alati, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Oh, who wouldn't love red
tulips? Their message is{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 13 00}a confession of true love!
{07 00 00}A long time ago, people got
obsessed about tulips. The
prices skyrocketed!
{07 06 00}Could you imagine if that
happened today?

{07 16 00}If tulips got that expensive
again, how would we afford
to confess our true love!?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kes ei armastaks punaseid
tulpe? Nende sõnum on{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 13 00}armastuse ülestunnistus!
{07 00 00}Ammu aega tagasi läksid
inimesed tulpidest hulluks.
Hinnad tõusid lakke!
{07 06 00}Kujutad ette, kui see
juhtuks täna?

{07 16 00}Kui tulbid nii kalliks
läheksid, kuidas me oma
armastust tunnistaksime!?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Really? You like white? They
send the message of{07 09 00} a
broken heart.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 14 00}I'll bet you never thought
such a pretty flower would
have such a sad meaning.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tõesti? Meeldib valge?
Nende sõnum on{07 09 00} murtud
süda.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}Vean kihla, et ei arvanud,
et nii ilusal lillel oleks
nii kurb tähendus.
